title: For every resolving-preserving exact tensor comparison
statement: For every resolving-preserving exact tensor comparison, its second-variable integer-shift square commutes, including the total-complex Koszul sign. The sites, functors and normalized tensor models are those of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-restriction-data]. The exact-derived model is the fixed termwise exact localization.

source.place: Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 0G7E; Modules on Sites, Tag 04J0; More on Algebra, Tag 0FNH

proof.text: For a fixed resolving argument, conjugate the comparison by the representative and exact-derived factor isomorphisms. Their normalized shifts and the total-bifunctor comparison shift theorem give the comparison shift square. Resolve arbitrary derived objects by flat-term K-flat complexes; essential surjectivity extends each square to all objects in each variable. This gives the unsigned first-variable and Koszul-signed second-variable equations.

theorem exactTensorComparison_shiftSecond (L : Mod R ⥤ Mod S) [L.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L] [PreservesFiniteColimits L]
    [PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} L]
    (a : TensorModel R) (b : TensorModel S) [sa : TensorShifts a] [sb : TensorShifts b]
    (mu : ∀ M N : Mod R, L.obj (((tensor R).obj M).obj N) ≅
      ((tensor S).obj (L.obj M)).obj (L.obj N))
    (hn : ∀ {M M' N N' : Mod R} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N'),
      L.map (((tensor R).map f).app N ≫ ((tensor R).obj M').map g) ≫
        (mu M' N').hom =
      (mu M N).hom ≫ (((tensor S).map (L.map f)).app (L.obj N) ≫
        ((tensor S).obj (L.obj M')).map (L.map g)))
    (t : TensorComparison L (exactTensorModel L) a b mu) :
    ∀ (M N : Der R) (n : ℤ),
      t.comparison.hom.app (M, N⟦n⟧) ≫
        b.functor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) ((L.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso n).hom.app N)) ≫
        (((Functor.curry.obj b.functor).obj (L.mapDerivedCategory.obj M)).commShiftIso n).hom.app
          (L.mapDerivedCategory.obj N) =
      L.mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((((Functor.curry.obj a.functor).obj M).commShiftIso n).hom.app N) ≫
        (L.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso n).hom.app (a.functor.obj (M, N)) ≫
        (shiftFunctor (Der S) n).map (t.comparison.hom.app (M, N))
